decisions.reason: Applying the competitor reference to layout, structure, and navigation does not change the established Shatter House brand identity.
The accepted content and image reuse is already represented by the candidate's message-9 INTRODUCE; the visual-reference update adds no further change.
The SEO concern is already represented by the candidate's message-9 INTRODUCE, and the design-reference application does not establish an additional SEO rule.
Using the competitor site as a visual and navigation reference does not alter support for adding locations or the consistent location-template strategy.
The visual-reference decision does not change the master-site domain or its routing configuration.
The source specifies a design reference for navigation but does not change the requirement to display and link to available locations.
The layout and navigation reference has no effect on separate revenue and sales tracking for each location.
The layout and navigation reference does not alter separate booking management for each location.
